title: Poisson $n$-Lie algebras: constructions and the structure of solvable algebras
summary: In this paper, we develop a construction of Poisson $n$-Lie algebras that generalizes the Jacobian $n$-Lie construction. Using the Grassmann--Plücker relations, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions under which the resulting bracket defines a Poisson $n$-Lie algebra. We also prove that suitable quotients of tensor products of Poisson algebras carry natural Poisson $n$-Lie structures. Conversely, we give a tensor-type procedure that associates a Poisson algebra to a given Poisson $n$-Lie algebra.
